project_summary: UMC Outpatient Pharmacy Remodel, project 26.8.7154, at 1800 W. Charleston Blvd., Las Vegas, NV 89102, first-floor main lobby. Remodel within an operating hospital using existing normal and essential electrical distribution. Exhibit A identifies the work as 2026-05 and requires completion within 90 days of notice to proceed. This consolidation covers D1–D6; architectural plans, telecommunications plans, project-specific furniture drawings and the referenced Honeywell scope were not supplied.

spec_highlights.title: Electrical execution and healthcare systems
spec_highlights.summary: Separate essential branch raceways/boxes and individual neutrals; EGC in every raceway. Essential-power commissioning per 2022 FGI 1.2-8.1.5 and hospital coordination-study update for final sign-off. Minimum one-year warranty from acceptance; permits, records and O&M required.

spec_highlights.title: Materials and wiring methods
spec_highlights.summary: Copper THHN/THWN, specification-grade minimum 20A devices, patient-care hospital-grade green-dot receptacles and office/corridor tamper resistance. EMT permitted in dry protected interiors, but above-ceiling rigid and MC prohibition require clarification against E2.01.

spec_highlights.title: Substitutions
spec_highlights.summary: Drawing requests at least five business days before bid closing; engineer review and written owner-representative approval. Manual preaward approval by addendum; postaward requests through Contractor at least five working days before ordering. Shop-drawing approval is not substitution approval.

spec_highlights.title: Luminaire products
spec_highlights.summary: METALUX L1/L2, HALO L3, WAC LIGHTING L4/L5 and SURE-LITES X1. L1–L3 are 277V with 0–10V control; L4/L5 are 120V. Ordering strings are incomplete; coordinate finishes, ceiling trim, mounting and controls.

spec_highlights.title: Fire alarm and access-control provider
spec_highlights.summary: Maintain FA operation and obtain fire marshal approval before rough-in. Use project-compatible factory-certified components and connection technician with monitoring-agency acceptance. Honeywell coordination is mandatory, but the referenced scope is missing.

spec_highlights.title: Coordination and BIM
spec_highlights.summary: Project-specific coordination drawings, conduit 1-1/4 inches and larger, devices and dimensioned boxes; BIM integration and 3D clash analysis. Electrical supplies AutoCAD information for mechanical-led coordination. Weekly meetings and project-platform participation apply.

spec_highlights.title: Concealed-work records
spec_highlights.summary: Photograph conduit and concealed services before closure; keyed images submitted within three working days. Record actual circuitry/routes before concealment; provide annotated PDFs and final printed record drawings.

spec_highlights.title: Submittals and procurement
spec_highlights.summary: Allow 15 calendar days for initial review/resubmittals and 21 days for sequential review. Include factory wiring diagrams, clearances and project-specific field dimensions. Build these periods into the 90-day project schedule.

spec_highlights.title: Temporary electrical facilities
spec_highlights.summary: All-trade temporary power/lighting from approved Owner sources; verify metering procedures. Locally switched security/construction lighting, office power and continuous HEPA equipment power with single emergency shutoff. Secure WiFi responsibility needs allocation.

spec_highlights.title: Penetrations and restoration
spec_highlights.summary: Maintain airtight and rated assemblies; restore finishes to prescribed boundaries using original installers where required. ASTM E814/UL 1479 systems, qualified firestop installer with five years' experience, inspections before concealment and labels within six inches. Do not mix sealant types in a penetration.

spec_highlights.title: Acoustical seals and box pads
spec_highlights.summary: Seal electrical penetrations airtight; box backs/sides in sound-rated assemblies require putty pads and perimeter sealant. Fire-rated pads: Tremco TREMstop MP. Non-fire-rated listed options: Specified Technologies, Inc. Firestop Putty Pads or Hilti CP-617.

spec_highlights.title: Closeout and training
spec_highlights.summary: Startup/testing, AHJ releases, cleaning, spares, warranties and recorded training before turnover. O&M draft at least 30 days before training, final at least 15 days before. Factory-authorized instructors; seven-day training notice.

spec_highlights.title: Selective demolition and salvage
spec_highlights.summary: Protect occupied adjacent areas, verify disconnections, maintain through circuits and document conditions. Offer electrical salvage to Owner and move selected items onsite. Owner handles hazardous materials.

spec_highlights.title: Electrified door coordination
spec_highlights.summary: Coordinate frame boxes and factory door wiring paths. Owner standards include Schlage Electronics CO, LCN Sentronics and Sr./Senior Swing, and 1511S delayed egress. Exhibit A identifies Von Duprin PS 914 or equal. AD Systems ExamSlide is no-substitution with an optional magnetic lock; opening selections and electrical interfaces are missing.

spec_highlights.title: Uniweb reference literature
spec_highlights.summary: Sample factory-prewired configurations only; no project quantities or selected models. One-inch data conduit is catalog information, not a measured project run. Red Special Purpose ISO is not automatically hospital emergency power.

spec_highlights.title: Owner execution requirements
spec_highlights.summary: 90 days from notice to proceed; long-lead orders within two weeks of associated purchase order. Continuous hospital access, 72-hour operational-area coordination, minimum 48-hour outage notice, badging, infection-control compliance, hot-work permits and third-party inspections. Work-hour and storage conflicts require resolution.

spec_highlights.title: Roller shades
spec_highlights.summary: Manual chain-and-clutch products conflict with a motor-connection execution clause. No electrical shade quantity is inferred.

electrical_scope_summary: G3 carries selective electrical demolition and make-safe work, pharmacy receptacles and branch-circuit extensions, modifications to existing panelboards, new lighting and controls, six fire/smoke-damper power connections and the explicitly shown VV-2-N connection. Carry temporary electrical services, electrical restoration, healthcare grounding and branch separation, essential-power commissioning and the hospital coordination-study update. Fire alarm is design-build with Honeywell coordination; its vendor/subcontract boundary remains unresolved. Communications rough-ins and furniture infrastructure connections are required, while E0.01 assigns communications cabling and devices to others. Exhibit A separately requires removal, storage and reinstallation of existing telemetry, Centrak and wireless access devices. The BOQ is a quantified-device baseline, not a complete material takeoff: branch wire/conduit footage, complete demolition lighting totals, L5 lengths and several vendor-designed systems remain unquantified.
other_trades_affecting_electrical: Mechanical furnishes six new smoke/fire dampers; E0.01 generally calls for 120V emergency control power, maximum ten devices per circuit. Actual actuator loads and interfaces remain unconfirmed.
Mechanical furnishes TITUS ESV VV-1-N and VV-2-N, both hydronic reheat, not electric heat. Electrical schedule data are absent; E2.01 explicitly depicts only VV-2-N connection.
Mechanical/controls handles five thermostat relocations and two new sensor locations under M0.01 ATC scope; sensors mount 48 inches AFF with locking covers.

FA duct detectors are furnished/wired by FA and installed by mechanical; standalone detectors are mechanical scope. Electrical conditionally furnishes separate detector access doors for mechanical installation.
Mechanical removes one existing SFD; G3 must coordinate electrical isolation and FA disposition. Nineteen existing SFDs remain.
GC operates containment and negative-air filtration continuously. Coordinate electrical capacity and the specified single emergency shutoff; equipment counts and ratings are absent.

Furniture/casework trade must provide selected prewired assembly details, cutout templates, connection points and cable management. Uniweb brochure colors do not establish hospital emergency branch identification.
Door/hardware trade must coordinate frame boxes, built-in wood-door wiring paths, electronic locks, LCN operators/closers and any power supplies with Honeywell and G3.
Carpentry backing is minimum 5/8-inch exterior A-C plywood where unspecified, with fire-retardant treatment. Confirm furnishing assignment.
Ceiling, sprinkler and HVAC trades must coordinate device positions, access and supports; occupancy/smoke devices require separation from air outlets under E0.00.
GC/original finish installers must coordinate matching restoration and flooring access restrictions, including work outside pharmacy limits.
Owner/GC must establish salvage destinations, access/badging and safe shutdown windows; Owner handles hazardous-material removal.
